name: Coliath

facts.text: Coliath (script class Colialt), level 78, 40,000 health. An ancient zombie spawns with it; at 30% it casts a life drain and follows its target.

story: Coliath holds the heights of Gwyddneau, the isle the old Welsh tales would call drowned, and guards something there. Nobody on the Isle of Glass can say what, and the garrison has a standing wager on it. An ancient dead thing rises from the ground beside it when it wakes, and when it is badly hurt, at a third of its strength, it fastens on its enemy and drinks the life out of them, following wherever they go. Whatever Coliath guards, it guards it hard enough to be the strongest named on the open isles.
legend: The strongest named on the isles' open ground. An ancient zombie wakes with it. At thirty percent it locks onto someone and drains their life while following them; that player keeps moving and the healers keep up. Whatever it guards is not worth dying for, the garrison says.

lairEntry: Something is guarded here. Nobody says what.

phases.text: Coliath fastens on its foe and drinks!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Coliath has fallen. What it guarded lies open.
